v1's "darwin" module and its /api/v1/darwin/* REST base were renamed to "codescan"/"/api/v1/codescan/*" as part of the v2 module rename (docs/MIGRATION.md §Module rename map) -- both sides are still a pure proxy to the same stub upstream (manager-contract.md §codescan), so the only byte-for-byte difference is the forwarded/echoed request path itself.

v1's asm router was a pure proxy to SCANNER_URL (scanner:5001), an HTTP server that never actually existed at runtime -- every real v1 call 503'd. The golden harness instead proxies both sides to the same deterministic echo stub, so v1's "response" here is just the stub's echoed method/path/query/body, not a real ASM result. v2 DECISION (phase12-scope-scan-monitor.md): re-architect ASM as a real DB-backed manager router (asm_scans + 6 supporting tables, migration 0006) publishing to a scanner:tasks stream, instead of porting the broken proxy. Every field in the response is therefore intentionally different in shape, not just value.

v2's HashLookupRequest lowercases the hash before comparing/echoing it back (case-insensitive hex lookup); v1 echoes the caller's casing verbatim. Same hash, normalized case only -- a miss on both sides either way.

Both sides correctly reject a refresh token presented as an access token token with 401, but v1's error string is the generic "Invalid token type" while v2 uses a more specific message ("Invalid token"). Cosmetic wording only -- status and envelope shape match.

v1 predates the hybrid static/assume_role credential model (services/s3scan/migrations/0002_s3scan_tenancy.sql) entirely, so it never had credential_mode/role_arn fields at all. v2 adds credential_mode (always present) and role_arn (present, null for static-mode buckets) to the bucket list/get response -- new, intentional fields, not a behavior mismatch. external_id is deliberately NOT among them: it is the AssumeRole confused-deputy shared secret and is stripped from the response DTO entirely (write-only), so it is never a source of diff on either side.

Same as decision-s3-buckets-new-credential-fields, for the single-bucket GET response: v2 adds credential_mode/role_arn (new, intentional fields absent from v1's pre-hybrid-credential schema). external_id is stripped from the response entirely on the v2 side, so it never appears here as a diff at all.
